headline: Europe has its first commercial orbital rocket
summary: German company Isar Aerospace successfully launched Europe's first commercial orbital rocket. The two-stage Spectrum vehicle reached low Earth orbit from a Norwegian spaceport. This follows a previous failed attempt in March.

headline: Boox’s tiny Picco e-reader should land in November
summary: Boox's new tiny Picco e-reader is expected to launch in November. Details emerged from IFA, though pricing information is still unavailable. Unlike competitors, the Picco will not feature magnets for attachment.

headline: The Fairphone 6 Plus is the midrange phone we desperately needed
summary: The Fairphone 6 Plus offers an admirable mission with ethically sourced and highly repairable components. This new midrange model avoids the performance sacrifices of previous Fairphones. It's praised for being a reliable, ethical Android phone.

headline: Competitive Pokémon is on phones now, but you still need a Switch to become a champion
summary: Competitive Pokémon battles are now accessible on mobile via the Pokémon Champions app. However, top-tier play, like at World Championships, still requires a Nintendo Switch. The article questions the necessity of this console exclusivity for high-level competition.

headline: The Batman Part 2 Goes in 'Another Totally Different Direction,' Robert Pattinson Teases
summary: Robert Pattinson teases a significantly different direction for The Batman Part 2. The sequel aims to offer a fresh and unique take on the DC superhero. Specific plot details remain under wraps.

headline: Zach Cregger Says He Feels Like He's 'Running for Office' Trying to Get Skeptical Resident Evil Fans 'Not to Call Me a LARPer'
summary: Resident Evil director Zach Cregger feels like he's on an 'apology tour' for his film adaptation. He's working to address skepticism from the franchise's dedicated fanbase. Cregger is trying to reassure fans amid strong reactions to the project.

headline: Exodus Ending and Character Fates Change Based on Your Choices
summary: The upcoming sci-fi RPG Exodus will feature player-driven choices that impact the game's ending. The narrative director confirms that character fates can change based on player decisions. This promises a highly reactive and personalized story experience.

headline: Riot Co-Founder Calls League of Legends MMO the 'Grail' Quest, 5 Years After It Was Announced
summary: Riot Games' long-awaited League of Legends MMO is still in active development, five years after its announcement. Co-founder Mark Merrill describes the ambitious project as the studio's 'grail quest.' The MMO aims to be a monumental title for Riot.

headline: German far-right set for big win in eastern state, projections show
summary: Germany's far-right AfD party is projected for a significant win in an eastern state. They are expected to secure over 44% of the vote, vastly outperforming the conservative CDU. The AfD has hailed this outcome as a 'historic result.'

headline: Zelensky says he expects war to continue into winter after talks with US envoys
summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky anticipates the ongoing war will continue into the winter months. This assessment follows recent talks with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner. The discussions concluded without any major breakthrough announcements.

headline: Minister to meet Jaguar Land Rover boss as thousands of job cuts expected
summary: A government minister is scheduled to meet with the CEO of Jaguar Land Rover. The meeting comes amid expectations of thousands of job cuts at the automotive company. JLR is struggling with the impact of tariffs and a major cyber attack.

headline: Jamaica to bring slavery reparations petition to King Charles
summary: Jamaica plans to present a slavery reparations petition directly to King Charles. The petition will ask the King to refer three specific questions to the Judicial Committee of the Privy Council. This move seeks to formally address historical injustices tied to slavery.
